newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Dev Bank gets expanded forex licence.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Dev Bank gets expanded forex licence.

text.p: The state-owned Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) had been given an expanded foreign currency deposit unit (FCDU) licence, allowing it to enter a full-range of foreign exchange transactions, the Central Bank said on Monday.
An expanded FCDU licence allows the bank to borrow from other FCDUs, invest in long-term foreign currency-denominated debt instruments, and grant long-term foreign currency loans.
A simple FCDU licence gives banks the authority to accept foreign exchange deposits, and borrow only short-term funds and invest in short-term instruments.
